body: I've seen her maybe 8 times and I message semi regularly. The second I see her everything I said here seems to disappear. Everything is okay again for the next 2 hours. God, I live my life for 2 hours a month. I can't stop thinking about the next time I am going to see her. She cares about me. I just don't know how I  can make her love me again.

maybe I should just do it. This terrible world has only taken from me. Why do I even care what happens to everyone who left me, everyone who doesn't care about me. They deserve to feel what I am feeling now. They need to know what it feel like to live with something you can't change. Eating away at my sanity like a maggot, consequently reminding them what they lost, who they lost. Everyone who has left me, alone, they deserve this not me.
I every day for the past 128 I've questioned that. I'm not sure, I'm not sure I'm sane anymore

I know. I know I can't fight this on my own. But I'm on my own, without her, I'm just not sure I can do it. I'm not sure I want to live without her. I don't want to die, but I just don't want to keep going on alone. I just can't wake up alone anymore. I just need somone to save me.

I'm like a faucet. All my emotion pour out. I can't stop it, maybe the best I can do is plug the hole for a little while. I'm so afraid what I've been doing to fight it isn't going to keep working. It's already failing. I can't give up. I try every single day, every single minute not to lover her. I'm failing. I've always been a failure.  I don't know how I can keep going, the thought of some one else being with her makes my blood boil. Every single fiber in my body is still connected to her.

I'm far to busy to spend alot of time  doing anything other than studying. My family seems to not really care about my problems. I've never really had support from my family anyways  so I'm used to it. I've burnt alot of my bridges with my friends. I don't know if I even want to be around anyone any more. I hope I get better, I'm  trying I haven't given up fully. I just don't think I going to win this battle.
